When enabled, Cowork, Code, and Chat sessions place only tool names in context up front, and Claude fetches a tool's full schema the first time it needs it. Use this when many MCP tools are configured and their inlined schemas crowd out the context window. If your endpoint does not accept the request shape it then receives, requests fail with HTTP 400.

- **Claude API, Vertex AI, Bedrock, or Bedrock Mantle with no custom base URL**: not needed. The app leaves Claude Code's experimental betas on there, as terminal Claude Code does, so tool search is on by default (on Vertex AI, for Claude 4.5 and newer models). To turn it off in Code, Cowork, and Chat, set `ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH` to `false` in the `env` block of OS-level Claude Code managed settings (with `parentSettingsBehavior: "merge"`). Earlier app versions treat these like the last case.
- **Gateway provider, app versions bundling Claude Code 2.1.247 or later**: requests add only the tool-search shape (the `tool-search-tool-2025-10-19` `anthropic-beta` value, deferred tool loading, `tool_reference` content blocks); every other experimental Claude Code beta stays suppressed. OS-level Claude Code managed settings that keep that suppression or turn `ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH` off still win; set `ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH` to `force` there instead (with `parentSettingsBehavior: "merge"`). Sessions the app runs in Claude Code's gateway mode (an opt-in for users on the gateway's own sign-in) get its gateway-safe tool-search shape instead.
- **Foundry, a custom base URL, and earlier app versions**: the app suppresses Claude Code's experimental betas for the session and the key lifts that, so requests carry the tool-search shape together with Claude Code's other experimental betas for that provider. On Vertex with app versions bundling Claude Code older than 2.1.221, leave this unset while any model older than Claude 4.5 is in use; those engines send the header regardless of model and Vertex's pre-4.5 stacks reject it.
rows.translation:
开启后，Cowork、Code 和聊天初始上下文仅放工具名称，Claude 首次需要工具时才获取完整 schema。配置了大量 MCP 工具、内联 schema 占用上下文时可使用。若端点不接受该请求格式，会报 HTTP 400。

- **Claude API、Vertex AI、Bedrock 或无自定义基础 URL 的 Bedrock Mantle：**无需设置。应用与终端 Claude Code 相同，保留实验 beta，工具搜索默认开启（Vertex AI 为 Claude 4.5 及更新模型）。若要在 Code、Cowork 和聊天关闭，请在操作系统级 Claude Code 托管设置的 `env` 块将 `ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH` 设为 `false`（配合 `parentSettingsBehavior: "merge"`）。较旧应用按下方最后一种情况处理。
- **网关提供商，内置 Claude Code 2.1.247 或更新版本的应用：**请求仅增加工具搜索格式（`tool-search-tool-2025-10-19` 的 `anthropic-beta` 值、延迟工具加载、`tool_reference` 内容块），其他实验 beta 仍被抑制。操作系统级托管设置若保持抑制或关闭 `ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH`，仍然优先；应在那里将 `ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH` 改为 `force`（配合 `parentSettingsBehavior: "merge"`）。应用以 Claude Code 网关模式运行的会话（网关自身登录用户可选）改用网关兼容的工具搜索格式。
- **Foundry、自定义基础 URL 及较旧应用：**应用默认抑制实验 beta，此键解除抑制，因此请求同时包含工具搜索格式及该提供商的其他实验 beta。Vertex 中，内置 Claude Code 早于 2.1.221 的应用如仍使用早于 Claude 4.5 的模型，应留空；那些引擎无论模型都会发送对应请求头，Vertex 的早期模型服务会拒绝它。

Before fetching a page, Claude Code's WebFetch tool asks `api.anthropic.com` whether the domain is on Anthropic's content blocklist, and refuses the fetch if that lookup cannot complete. Third-party deployments route inference elsewhere and often block `api.anthropic.com` at the firewall; with the lookup on, every WebFetch in Code sessions then fails with "Unable to verify if domain … is safe to fetch", and where the host is reachable, every fetched hostname is sent to Anthropic. (Cowork sessions fetch through the app's own allowlisted fetch and never run this lookup.)

Off (default): the lookup runs as it does today, so `api.anthropic.com` must be reachable from users' machines for Code-session WebFetch to work (listed under Egress Requirements). Set to `true` when users' machines cannot reach `api.anthropic.com` (corporate firewall, government network) or you do not want fetched hostnames sent there: Code sessions then fetch without the lookup and never contact that host for it. This is the same `skipWebFetchPreflight` setting Claude Code reads from its own [managed-settings](
rows.translation:
抓取页面前，Claude Code 的 WebFetch 向 `api.anthropic.com` 查询域名是否在 Anthropic 内容阻止名单中；查询无法完成时拒绝抓取。第三方部署将推理路由至其他提供商，常在防火墙阻止 `api.anthropic.com`，因此保留查询会使 Code 的每次 WebFetch 报“Unable to verify if domain … is safe to fetch”。主机可达时，每个抓取主机名都会发送给 Anthropic。Cowork 使用应用自身允许名单抓取，不执行此查询。

关闭（默认）时查询照常运行，用户设备须可访问 `api.anthropic.com`，Code WebFetch 才可用，该地址列于出站要求。设备因公司防火墙或政府网络无法访问 `api.anthropic.com`，或不希望发送抓取主机名时，可设为 `true`：Code 将不查询就抓取，也不再为此联系该主机。对应 Claude Code 自身读取的 `skipWebFetchPreflight`，参见[托管设置](

rows.original: /code#interaction-with-claude-code%E2%80%99s-own-managed-settings) file; the app passes it to every session it starts. To restrict which domains Claude may fetch, use `coworkEgressAllowedHosts` or `builtinToolPolicy` instead.

Paths can reference `~` and these environment variables, expanded per user: `%OneDrive%`, `%OneDriveCommercial%`, `%OneDriveConsumer%`, `%APPDATA%`, `%LOCALAPPDATA%`, `%USERNAME%`, `%XDG_DOCUMENTS_DIR%`. The set is fixed; an entry that references any other `%VAR%`, or one that is unset on the device, is ignored.

Each folder is interpreted on the machine the session runs on. For a Code session on an SSH host, `~` means the remote user's home, an entry that references a `%VAR%` is ignored there (environment variables belong to the machine that defines them), and the session's working directory must fall inside one of the folders as they exist on that host. One list serves every machine: `["/Users", "~"]` governs `/Users` on a managed Mac and the signed-in user's home on a Linux host. A folder that names nothing real on a given machine simply allows nothing there. An empty list allows no folder at all; unset leaves access unrestricted.
rows.translation:
路径可引用 `~` 及以下按用户展开的环境变量：`%OneDrive%`、`%OneDriveCommercial%`、`%OneDriveConsumer%`、`%APPDATA%`、`%LOCALAPPDATA%`、`%USERNAME%`、`%XDG_DOCUMENTS_DIR%`。集合固定，引用其他 `%VAR%` 或设备未设置变量的条目会被忽略。

文件夹在会话运行的机器上解释。SSH 主机上的 Code 会话中，`~` 表示远程用户主目录；引用 `%VAR%` 的条目被忽略，因为环境变量属于定义它的机器。工作目录须位于该主机实际存在的某个允许文件夹内。同一列表可用于所有机器：`["/Users", "~"]` 在受管理 Mac 上控制 `/Users`，在 Linux 主机上控制已登录用户主目录。不对应实际文件夹的条目在该机器不允许任何路径。空列表不允许任何文件夹，未设置则不限制。

rows.original:
When set to `true`, Code sessions refuse reads outside their working directories (the session folder plus any `allowedWorkspaceFolders`). The file tools (Read, Grep, Glob) refuse them in every permission mode; where Claude Code's sandbox runs (macOS, or Linux and SSH hosts with bubblewrap, once `allowedWorkspaceFolders` or an egress allowlist is also configured) shell commands cannot see the home directory and other user folders (`/Users`, `/home`, mounted volumes) and a read there is refused with no prompt; elsewhere (Windows, Linux without bubblewrap, or neither folders nor an egress allowlist configured) such shell reads prompt for approval. The app keeps the user's git configuration files (which may themselves embed credentials such as URL tokens; a symlinked one stays hidden), its own Claude Code installation, and the session's plugin and attachment folders readable (not on a Windows SSH host, where plugin files and attachments stay out of the file tools' reach under the block). An allowed folder that is or contains the home directory leaves it readable.

Users can re-open folders (even their whole home) in their own Claude Code settings with `sandbox.filesystem.allowRead` or `permissions.additionalDirectories`; settings files tracked in a git repository cannot. The key travels on Claude Code's managed-settings channel: another Claude Code managed-settings source replaces it unless that source sets `parentSettingsBehavior` to `"merge"`, and one that sets `sandbox.filesystem.allowManagedReadPathsOnly` reduces it to approval prompts. This is `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` in Claude Code's [managed settings](
rows.translation:
设为 `true` 时，Code 拒绝读取工作目录之外的文件（会话目录加 `allowedWorkspaceFolders`）。Read、Grep、Glob 在所有权限模式均拒绝此类读取。Claude Code 沙箱可运行的环境（macOS，或安装 bubblewrap 的 Linux/SSH 主机，且配置 `allowedWorkspaceFolders` 或出站允许名单）中，shell 看不到主目录及其他用户文件夹（`/Users`、`/home`、挂载卷），读取直接拒绝，不提示。其他环境（Windows、未安装 bubblewrap 的 Linux，或未配置文件夹和出站允许名单）对 shell 读取询问审批。应用仍允许读取 git 配置文件（可能含 URL 令牌等凭据；符号链接文件保持隐藏）、自身 Claude Code 安装、会话插件及附件目录；Windows SSH 主机例外，限制开启时其文件工具不能读取插件和附件。允许目录若为或包含主目录，主目录仍可读。

用户可在个人 Claude Code 设置中通过 `sandbox.filesystem.allowRead` 或 `permissions.additionalDirectories` 重新开放文件夹，甚至整个主目录；git 跟踪的设置文件不能这样做。此键通过 Claude Code 托管设置传递，其他来源会替换它，除非将 `parentSettingsBehavior` 设为 `"merge"`；设置 `sandbox.filesystem.allowManagedReadPathsOnly` 的来源会将限制降为审批提示。对应 Claude Code 的 `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories`，参见[托管设置](

Unset (default): nothing changes.

Sessions started inside a WSL distro run Claude Code where Windows host endpoint policy (this managed configuration, and Claude Code's own managed-settings.json) does not apply. On a device with any managed configuration present, WSL sessions are blocked unless this key is explicitly set to `false`. Set to `true` to block WSL sessions unconditionally; set to `false` to allow them on managed devices; leave unset to block whenever the device is managed.

This key is honored only when deployed through machine-scoped management — MDM on macOS, the HKLM policy hive on Windows, the root-owned `/etc` file on Linux — never via the in-app Setup panel or user-writable stores; in particular, an explicit `false` written to the user-writable HKCU hive is ignored (and its presence still marks the device as managed). Because the key is grouped with the other app-behavior keys, deploying it claims that whole group: the auto-update keys (`disableAutoUpdates`, `autoUpdaterEnforcementHours`, …) are then resolved from the managed tier alone, and any local- or remote-tier values for them stop applying.
rows.translation:
WSL 发行版内运行 Claude Code 不受 Windows 主机端点策略（本配置及 Claude Code 自身 managed-settings.json）约束。设备存在托管配置时，除非此键明确为 `false`，否则阻止 WSL。`true` 始终阻止，`false` 允许受管理设备使用；未设置则受管理时阻止。

仅机器范围管理部署生效：macOS MDM、Windows HKLM 策略分支、Linux root 所有的 `/etc` 文件。应用面板和用户可写存储不生效，HKCU 显式 `false` 也被忽略，但其存在仍标记设备为受管理。此键与应用行为键成组，部署即接管整组；自动更新键（`disableAutoUpdates`、`autoUpdaterEnforcementHours` 等）只读托管层，本地或远程值不再适用。

rows.original:
When `true` and Claude Code's managed settings name a corporate launcher in `processWrapper` or `env.CLAUDE_CODE_PROCESS_WRAPPER`, the Code tab starts the app's Claude Code through it: on this device (managed-settings file or MDM profile, never server-managed), and, for an SSH session, through the one in the host's managed-settings files (`/etc/claude-code`; `/Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode` on macOS). Either way it is handed none of the app's inference credential (claude.ai sign-in, provider key, token, auth header or credential file) and reads no stored login or ambient cloud credential of this device (over SSH, the host account's own environment still applies); the launcher must put one in its environment — `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` with `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` or `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, or, for the Bedrock, Vertex or Foundry routing the app leaves set (`CLAUDE_CODE_USE_*`; override to switch), that provider's keys or credential file — or the start fails; it makes no non-essential Anthropic calls. The third-party connection test and title generation start directly. An unusable launcher, an unreadable host settings file or another Claude Code version refuses or ends the session with an error. Device launcher: macOS and Linux (ignored on Windows); SSH hosts: Linux or macOS, from any device; never WSL or Cowork; both deployment modes.

Unset or `false` (default): the app never reads that setting and starts Claude Code directly, with its own credential. A change applies at the next Claude Code start on third party (a served value once fetched) and at the next app launch on a claude.ai install (profile or local configuration file).

The key is in the app-behavior group (`disableAutoUpdates`, …): a profile that sets any group key is the only source read for all of them — set it in the profile, with every group key you need, when the profile sets any of them or the launcher must hold against the device's own user; else in the admin console or configuration server.
rows.translation:
设为 `true`，且 Claude Code 托管设置在 `processWrapper` 或 `env.CLAUDE_CODE_PROCESS_WRAPPER` 指定公司启动器时，Code 通过它启动应用内 Claude Code。本机读取托管文件或 MDM，不读取服务器托管值；SSH 读取主机托管文件（`/etc/claude-code`，macOS 为 `/Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode`）。启动器不取得应用推理凭据（claude.ai 登录、提供商密钥、令牌、认证头或凭据文件），也不读取本机保存登录或环境云凭据（SSH 主机账户自身环境仍适用）。启动器必须在环境中提供 `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` 配合 `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` 或 `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`，或应用保留的 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 路由（`CLAUDE_CODE_USE_*`，可覆盖切换）所需提供商密钥/凭据文件，否则启动失败。不会执行非必要 Anthropic 调用。第三方连接测试和标题生成仍直接启动。启动器不可用、主机设置不可读或使用另一 Claude Code 版本会拒绝或结束会话并报错。本机支持 macOS/Linux，Windows 忽略；SSH 主机支持 Linux/macOS，可从任意设备连接；不适用于 WSL/Cowork，两种部署模式均支持。

未设置或 `false`（默认）时，应用不读取启动器设置，携带自身凭据直接启动。第三方模式在下次启动 Claude Code 时应用更改（服务器值获取后），claude.ai 安装在下次应用启动时应用设备配置或本地文件值。

属于应用行为组（`disableAutoUpdates` 等）。设备配置设置任一组键后，整组仅从该配置读取。因此已设置组键，或须对本机用户强制启动器时，应在同一配置放入本键及所需全部组键；否则可由管理控制台或配置服务器下发。

rows.original:
AD Folder Redirection can point %APPDATA% at a network (UNC) share, where Cowork tasks fail to start. The sandbox cannot mount a network path. With this key set to `true`, the app stores its data in a product-specific `<ProductName>-Data` folder under %LOCALAPPDATA% on such devices instead. The key only takes effect when %APPDATA% actually resolves to a UNC path, so it is a no-op on devices with a local profile and does not move a healthy install.

Because the key is grouped with the other app-behavior keys, deploying it claims that whole group: the auto-update keys (`disableAutoUpdates`, `autoUpdaterEnforcementHours`, …) are then resolved from the managed tier alone, and any local- or remote-tier values for them stop applying. Deploy it together with any auto-update keys you rely on in the same managed (MDM / HKLM `Policies\Claude`) tier.

The relocation is a fresh start, not a move: nothing is carried over from the share. The new local folder begins empty, so users sign in again and re-enter their settings, preferences, and MCP server configuration after the move. Nothing is deleted from the share either; removing the key returns the app to the share with its previous contents (including the previous sign-in state) intact, so the rollback path keeps working.
rows.translation:
AD 文件夹重定向可能将 %APPDATA% 指向网络 UNC 共享，使 Cowork 无法启动：沙箱不能挂载网络路径。设为 `true` 后，此类设备改将数据存于 %LOCALAPPDATA% 下产品专用 `<ProductName>-Data` 文件夹。仅在 %APPDATA% 实际为 UNC 路径时生效，不影响本地用户配置，也不移动正常安装。

此键与应用行为键成组，部署即接管整组。自动更新键（`disableAutoUpdates`、`autoUpdaterEnforcementHours` 等）只读托管层，本地/远程值不再适用。应与所依赖更新键放在同一托管层（MDM / HKLM `Policies\Claude`）。

这是全新开始，不迁移数据：共享内容不会带过来，本地目录为空，用户须重新登录并输入设置、偏好及 MCP 配置。共享也不删除内容；移除此键后返回共享，原内容及登录状态完整保留，支持恢复。

rows.original: Applies to **both** Cowork and Code, and only to **tool calls**. In Cowork it governs the sandbox's web fetch, shell commands, and package installs; in Code sessions it is [translated into Claude Code's network sandbox allowlist](
rows.translation: 适用于 **Cowork 和 Code**，仅控制**工具调用**。Cowork 控制沙箱网页抓取、shell、包安装；Code 会[转换为 Claude Code 网络沙箱允许名单](

rows.original:
/code#applied-as-managed-policy), where a separately deployed Claude Code managed-settings file takes precedence by default. It does **not** cover Web Search (which runs at your inference provider), inference, or MCP traffic. A list other than `*` also bounds where Claude may browse in the built-in browser. When unset, only the inference endpoint is reachable from the sandbox, so the agent's package installs and web fetches fail with a 403.

Entries are exact hostnames (`api.github.com`), wildcards (`*.corp.com` matches subdomains at any depth, not `corp.com` itself), or `*` to allow all. IP addresses match only when listed exactly. `localhost` and private-network addresses are always blocked for web fetch; shell commands and package installs run in a network sandbox that reaches only the listed hosts plus your inference provider. With `*`, that sandbox is disabled and web fetch still blocks private addresses.

Any entry except bare `*` may carry a `:port` suffix (`internal.corp.com:8443`, `*.corp.com:8443`) restricting it to that port. IPv6 literals are not supported. An invalid entry is dropped (with a warning in the app log) and the rest keep working; an unreadable value counts as an empty list. Ports are enforced for the Cowork sandbox's web fetch, shell, and package-install egress; plugin CLIs ignore port-scoped entries for now, and the Code translation treats them as the bare host. Deploy port-scoped entries only once your whole fleet is on a build that supports them (`disableAutoUpdates` pins builds): on an older build one such entry invalidates the sandbox's whole shell and package-install allowlist for the session.

Listed hosts also need to be open on your network firewall.
rows.translation:
/code#applied-as-managed-policy)，默认由独立部署的托管文件优先。**不控制**提供商处运行的网页搜索、推理或 MCP 流量。非 `*` 列表也限制内置浏览器可访问站点。未设置时沙箱仅可达推理端点，包安装及抓取会报 403。

条目可为精确主机名（`api.github.com`）、通配符（`*.corp.com` 匹配任意层级子域，不匹配 `corp.com` 本身），或允许全部的 `*`。IP 仅精确列出时匹配。抓取始终阻止 `localhost` 和私网地址；shell 和包安装的网络沙箱仅可达名单及推理提供商。`*` 关闭此沙箱，抓取仍阻止私网。

除单独 `*` 外，条目可加 `:port` 后缀（`internal.corp.com:8443`、`*.corp.com:8443`）限制端口，不支持 IPv6 字面地址。无效条目丢弃并写日志警告，其余继续生效；不可读值视为空列表。端口控制 Cowork 抓取、shell、包安装，插件 CLI 暂忽略端口条目，Code 按普通主机转换。全设备群支持后才部署端口条目（`disableAutoUpdates` 可固定版本）；旧版本遇到一个此类条目就会使会话整个 shell/包安装名单无效。

名单主机也须在网络防火墙放行。

rows.original:
Pins the app (sign-in, the connection test, model discovery, MCP servers, plugins), the Claude Code engine behind Chat, Cowork, and Code, and on macOS and Windows the Cowork workspace VM (the agent's shell, package-install, `git`, and plugin commands) to one HTTP proxy. Use it when your gateway or the internet is reachable only through a corporate proxy and you cannot rely on the system proxy. It is a reachability setting, not an egress control.

The value is an `http://` or `https://` URL, usually with a port. SOCKS proxies and embedded credentials (`user:pass@`) are rejected. Give a local forwarding proxy on the device as `http://127.0.0.1:port`; an `https://` loopback address cannot be verified from inside the Cowork workspace VM. Requests to `localhost`, `127.0.0.1`, `[::1]`, and `*.local` names bypass the proxy so local MCP servers keep working; everything else goes through it, and if the proxy is unreachable requests fail rather than connect directly. The engine receives it as `HTTPS_PROXY` and `HTTP_PROXY` with a matching `NO_PROXY`; if Claude Code managed settings on the device set those variables, they win for the engine on the host. Traffic that never uses this proxy: the Cowork workspace VM on Linux, credential and header helper scripts, the update download, the Windows sign-in broker, and pages opened in the system browser.

Read once at launch from device management (MDM) or the local configuration file only; a configuration server cannot deliver it, because the app may need the proxy to reach that server. A profile that sets only this key (or only the other app-behavior keys, such as `disableAutoUpdates`) does not take over a connection users set up in the app, but those keys are read from one source as a group, so put the proxy in the same profile as your update settings. Changes apply at the next app start. When `egressProxyPacUrl` is also set, the PAC file wins and this key is ignored.
rows.translation:
将应用（登录、连接测试、模型发现、MCP、插件）、聊天/Cowork/Code 背后的 Claude Code 引擎，以及 macOS/Windows Cowork 虚拟机（shell、包安装、`git`、插件命令）固定到一个 HTTP 代理。适用于只能通过公司代理访问网关或互联网、不能依赖系统代理的环境。这是连通性设置，不是出站控制。

值为 `http://` 或 `https://` URL，通常含端口；拒绝 SOCKS 及嵌入凭据（`user:pass@`）。本机转发代理使用 `http://127.0.0.1:port`，虚拟机内无法验证 `https://` 回环地址。`localhost`、`127.0.0.1`、`[::1]`、`*.local` 请求绕过代理，确保本地 MCP；其他均走代理，不可达则失败，不直接连接。引擎收到 `HTTPS_PROXY`、`HTTP_PROXY` 及对应 `NO_PROXY`，本机 Claude Code 托管设置若定义它们，对主机引擎优先。Linux 虚拟机、凭据/请求头助手、更新下载、Windows 登录代理及系统浏览器页面不使用此代理。

仅启动时从 MDM 或本地配置读取，服务器不能下发，因为访问服务器可能需要代理。只设此键或其他行为键（如 `disableAutoUpdates`）的设备配置不接管用户连接，但组键均从同一来源读取，请与更新设置放在同一配置。下次启动生效，同时设置 `egressProxyPacUrl` 时 PAC 优先，此键忽略。

rows.original:
At launch the app downloads the PAC script and asks it which proxy to use for each request, as a browser would, instead of following the operating system's proxy settings. Same value rules, coverage, exclusions, and delivery as `egressProxyUrl`, except that bypassing is the script's decision: `localhost`, `127.0.0.1`, and `[::1]` still never use a proxy, but `*.local` names and everything else follow whatever it returns. If the PAC file cannot be downloaded, the app connects directly rather than failing.

On macOS and Windows the Cowork workspace VM is handed a copy of the script when it starts and evaluates it for each request itself; there `myIpAddress()` returns the VM's internal address rather than the device's, so a script that chooses by client subnet gives the VM its off-network answer (if that download fails, the VM connects directly). The Claude Code engine behind Chat, Cowork, and Code cannot evaluate a PAC file, so the app hands it one proxy (whichever the script returns for your inference endpoint) plus a bypass for loopback and `*.local` names. If the script answers `DIRECT` or only `SOCKS` for that endpoint, the engine uses no proxy at all, so have it return an HTTP `PROXY host:port` entry there; if the engine needs different rules, set `HTTPS_PROXY` and `NO_PROXY` in Claude Code managed settings, which win for the engine on the host.
rows.translation:
启动时下载 PAC，像浏览器逐请求确定代理，不使用系统代理设置。值规则、范围、例外及下发同 `egressProxyUrl`，但绕过由脚本决定；`localhost`、`127.0.0.1`、`[::1]` 始终不走代理，`*.local` 及其他名称按结果处理。PAC 下载失败则直接连接，不报失败。

macOS/Windows Cowork 虚拟机启动时取得脚本副本，自行逐请求计算。其中 `myIpAddress()` 返回虚拟机内部地址而非设备地址，按客户端子网判断的脚本会给虚拟机返回外网答案；下载失败则直接连接。Claude Code 不能执行 PAC，应用给它推理端点对应的一个代理，并绕过回环及 `*.local`。返回 `DIRECT` 或仅 `SOCKS` 时引擎完全不走代理，应让此端点返回 HTTP `PROXY host:port`。需不同规则时，在 Claude Code 托管设置设 `HTTPS_PROXY` 和 `NO_PROXY`，对主机引擎优先。

rows.original:
The path on the user's computer of the signed package your endpoint security (EDR) vendor supplies for the Cowork workspace VM. Put its signature file beside the file this path points to, named as that file plus `.sig`. Keep both, and every folder above them, where ordinary users cannot write. Each time the workspace VM starts, it checks that signature and, only if it is from the vendor named in `coworkEDRIntegrationVendor`, which you must also set, runs the package's `install.sh` as root to install or update the sensor. The signature covers only the package file, `install.sh` included; what the sensor downloads afterwards, including its own updates, is the vendor's and is not checked by Claude. macOS only.

Claude reads this key only from configuration that only an administrator can install: an MDM profile on macOS, or the root-owned file under `/etc/claude-desktop` on Linux. It ignores the key in the in-app Setup panel, in any file the user can edit, and from a configuration server. It is one of the app-behavior keys (`disableAutoUpdates`, `relaunchEnforcementHours`, `egressProxyUrl`, …), which Claude takes as a set: once your profile sets any of them, values for the others from a local file or a configuration server stop applying, so put every one you use in the same profile.

Unset (default): no vendor package is installed in the workspace VM. Removing this key only stops later runs of the package. It does not remove or stop a sensor already installed, which stays on the workspace VM's disk until that VM is deleted or replaced.

Network access: `install.sh` and whatever it installs run as root in the workspace VM and are not part of any session, so the network egress allowlist, the proxy keys (`egressProxyUrl`, `egressProxyPacUrl`) and the device's proxy settings do not apply to them. Claude does not otherwise limit which internet hosts they can reach; their connections are ordinary traffic from the device, subject to your own network-layer controls.
rows.translation:
EDR 厂商提供的 Cowork 工作区虚拟机签名包在用户电脑上的路径。旁边放签名文件，名称为包名加 `.sig`。文件及全部上级目录须禁止普通用户写入。虚拟机每次启动检查签名，仅来自同时必填 `coworkEDRIntegrationVendor` 指定厂商时，以 root 运行包的 `install.sh`，安装或更新传感器。签名只覆盖包文件（含 `install.sh`）；后续下载及自身更新由厂商负责，Claude 不检查。仅 macOS。

仅从管理员可安装配置读取：macOS MDM、Linux `/etc/claude-desktop` 下 root 所有文件。应用面板、用户可编辑文件及服务器值忽略。属于行为组（`disableAutoUpdates`、`relaunchEnforcementHours`、`egressProxyUrl` 等），设备配置设任一键后，其他组键不再读本地/服务器值，请放入同一配置。

未设置（默认）不安装厂商包。移除此键只停止后续运行，不移除或停止已有传感器；它留在虚拟机磁盘，直到虚拟机删除或替换。

网络：`install.sh` 及其安装内容以 root 运行，不属任何会话，出站名单、代理键（`egressProxyUrl`、`egressProxyPacUrl`）及设备代理不适用。Claude 不额外限制其互联网主机，作为设备普通流量受你自己的网络层控制。

rows.original:
The ID of the endpoint security (EDR) vendor that signed the package `coworkEDRIntegration` points to: 1 to 32 characters from a to z, 0 to 9 and the hyphen, not starting with a hyphen, for example `example-vendor`. It must be an ID this release of Claude accepts; ask your vendor which ID to use. Required whenever `coworkEDRIntegration` is set. The workspace VM runs the package only if this vendor signed it; a package signed by anyone else is refused, even another vendor this release of Claude accepts. The signature the VM checks is the `.sig` file described under `coworkEDRIntegration`. macOS only.

Claude reads this key only from the configuration described under `coworkEDRIntegration`, and ignores a value from anywhere else. It is one of the app-behavior keys (see `coworkEDRIntegration`), so put it in the same profile as every other app-behavior key you use.

Unset (default): if `coworkEDRIntegration` is set, nothing is installed, and each time the workspace VM starts `cowork_vm_node.log` in the app's logs folder records the reason, `vendor_not_named`. It records `config_invalid` for a value not of the form above and `vendor_unknown` for an ID this release of Claude does not accept; neither installs anything. To turn the feature off without these entries, remove `coworkEDRIntegration`, not this key. Removing either key only stops later runs: a sensor already installed stays on the workspace VM's disk until that VM is deleted or replaced.
rows.translation:
签署 `coworkEDRIntegration` 指向包的 EDR 厂商 ID，1–32 个 a–z、0–9 或连字符，不以连字符开头，如 `example-vendor`。须是本发行版接受的 ID，请向厂商确认。设置 `coworkEDRIntegration` 时必填。仅此厂商签名可运行，其他已支持厂商签名也拒绝。检查的是 `coworkEDRIntegration` 所述 `.sig` 文件。仅 macOS。

仅从 `coworkEDRIntegration` 所述配置读取，其他来源忽略。属于行为组（见 `coworkEDRIntegration`），与所需其他键放在同一配置。

未设置且已设 `coworkEDRIntegration` 时不安装，虚拟机每次启动在应用日志目录 `cowork_vm_node.log` 记录 `vendor_not_named`。格式错误记录 `config_invalid`，不接受的 ID 记录 `vendor_unknown`，均不安装。若要关闭而不产生记录，应移除 `coworkEDRIntegration`，不是本键。移除任一键只停止后续运行，已装传感器保留至虚拟机删除或替换。

rows.original:
When set to `true`, the Cowork workspace VM on macOS and Windows gets a static IPv6 address (a unique local `fd…` address) and an IPv6 default route on its virtual network next to its IPv4 address, and the VM's gateway forwards that traffic over the device's own IPv6 connectivity, as it already does for IPv4. Use it when the tools the agent runs in the VM (shell commands, package installs, `git`, and plugin commands) must reach IPv6-only destinations. The VM's resolver then also returns IPv6 (AAAA) answers. A connection the VM makes over IPv6 succeeds only where the device's own IPv6 does; on a device without working IPv6, destinations that have both keep working over IPv4 and IPv6-only destinations stay unreachable. Because the VM's address is unique-local, most tools in it keep preferring IPv4 for destinations that have both, so IPv6 mostly carries traffic to IPv6-only destinations.

This is a reachability setting, not an egress control: `coworkEgressAllowedHosts` keeps deciding which hostnames the agent's tools may reach, by name, over either protocol, and IPv6 literals are still not accepted there. Hosts your policies allow must also be reachable, and filtered the way you intend, over IPv6 on your network.

Unset (default): the VM is IPv4-only and its resolver returns no IPv6 answers. A change takes effect the next time the workspace VM starts, typically at the next app launch. Does not apply to the Cowork workspace VM on Linux or to Code sessions, which use the device's own network stack.
rows.translation:
设为 `true` 后，macOS/Windows Cowork 虚拟机在 IPv4 外获得静态 IPv6 唯一本地 `fd…` 地址及默认路由，网关通过设备自身 IPv6 转发，与 IPv4 相同。shell、包安装、`git`、插件命令需访问仅 IPv6 目标时可使用，解析器也返回 AAAA。只有设备自身 IPv6 可用，虚拟机 IPv6 才成功；没有可用 IPv6 时，双栈仍走 IPv4，仅 IPv6 目标不可达。唯一本地地址使多数工具对双栈仍优先 IPv4，主要承载仅 IPv6 流量。

这是连通性设置，不是出站控制，`coworkEgressAllowedHosts` 仍按名称控制两种协议主机，不接受 IPv6 字面地址。允许的主机也须在 IPv6 网络可达并按预期过滤。

默认虚拟机仅 IPv4，解析器不返回 IPv6。下次虚拟机启动、通常下次应用启动生效。不适用 Linux Cowork 或使用设备网络栈的 Code。

rows.original: When on (default), the app resolves the signed-in user's identity from the configured credential source (the identity provider claim, or the OS login name when no claim is available) and shows it in the sidebar footer, the account menu, and the Code session greeting. If an OpenTelemetry collector is configured, the same identity is also emitted as the `enduser.id` resource attribute on every span, metric, and log sent to your collector — unless you have set a static `enduser.id` under OpenTelemetry resource attributes, in which case your static value is kept and the runtime identity is not emitted. When off, no identity is shown in the app and no runtime `enduser.id` is emitted; a static `enduser.id` under OpenTelemetry resource attributes still passes through unchanged. This setting does not gate the `process.owner` resource attribute (the OS login name), which is standard OpenTelemetry process metadata and is always emitted — set a static `process.owner` under OpenTelemetry resource attributes to override it. Applies to both Cowork tasks and Code sessions.
rows.translation: 开启时（默认），应用从凭据来源取得用户身份（IdP 声明，无声明时用操作系统登录名），显示于侧边栏底部、账户菜单及 Code 欢迎语。配置 OTEL 采集器时，同一身份作为每个 span、指标、日志的 `enduser.id` 属性发送；已设静态 `enduser.id` 则保留它，不发送运行时身份。关闭时不显示身份，不发送运行时 `enduser.id`，但静态 `enduser.id` 仍原样传递。不控制标准进程元数据 `process.owner`（操作系统登录名），始终发送，可设静态 `process.owner` 覆盖。适用于 Cowork/Code。

rows.original:
Free-text instructions from your organization that Claude Desktop appends, in a clearly delimited block, after its own system prompt in **Chat**, **Cowork**, and **Code** (every chat, task, and Code session, including the sub-agents they spawn): for example house style, data-handling rules, or topics to decline. The model is told these instructions come from the organization's administrator and take priority over a user's personal preferences.

This is guidance the model follows, not an enforced control: like any system-prompt text it steers the model's behavior and is usually honored, but it does not guarantee an outcome and is not a substitute for the restriction keys (tool policy, egress allowlist, folder allowlist). The app's own system prompt is never replaced or shortened by this key; in Code sessions it is added after Claude Code's own prompt and any `CLAUDE.md` instructions still apply.

Read from the app's loaded configuration when a session starts; a changed value generally takes effect for sessions started after the next app launch. Leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed; an empty string is treated as unset. Maximum 3,000 characters; a longer value is rejected (the key is ignored with a configuration error) rather than truncated. Line breaks are preserved when the value is delivered as JSON, a bootstrap response, a `.mobileconfig` profile, or a `.reg` file; the Group Policy (ADMX) and Intune text box for this setting is single-line.
rows.translation:
组织自由文本指令，Claude Desktop 在自身系统提示后以清晰分隔块追加，适用于**聊天**、**Cowork**、**Code** 全部对话、任务、会话及其子代理，如内部风格、数据处理规则或拒绝话题。模型被告知来自组织管理员，优先于个人偏好。

这是模型指导，不是强制控制；通常会遵循，但不保证结果，不能替代工具策略、出站或文件夹名单。不会替换或缩短应用提示；Code 追加在 Claude Code 提示后，`CLAUDE.md` 仍适用。

会话启动时读取已加载配置，一般对下次应用启动后创建的会话生效。去掉首尾空白，空串视为未设置。最多 3,000 字符，超长拒绝并记录配置错误，不截断。JSON、引导响应、`.mobileconfig` 配置、`.reg` 文件保留换行；组策略 ADMX 和 Intune 文本框单行。

rows.original: Set through your device management (MDM or machine policy) to the UUID of the organization your users sign in to; a value in a user's own configuration file is ignored. After a user signs in to that organization in Claude Desktop on a computer where an earlier third-party configuration of Claude Desktop left chats, Cowork tasks or Code sessions, the app copies them into the user's first-party profile on the same computer. Nothing is uploaded by the copy; once the user resumes a copied session it behaves like any other first-party session. The copy runs in the background, once per account and organization, and leaves the originals in place. Without this key, the organization's own setting (Admin settings in claude.ai) decides, and a deployed key takes precedence over it. A value that is not a UUID is reported as a configuration error and copies nothing; one that names a different organization than the one signed in copies nothing and is noted in the app's log. Like other first-party keys, deploying it puts the app's configuration under management, so a third-party connection a user set up in the app's own settings no longer applies. Anthropic can switch the copy off remotely.
rows.translation: 由 MDM 或机器策略设为登录组织 UUID，用户自身配置文件忽略。登录该组织后，若本机此前第三方配置留下聊天/Cowork/Code，后台复制到本机第一方用户配置，每账户和组织一次，原件保留。复制不上传；继续会话后与其他第一方会话一样。未设时由 claude.ai 组织管理设置决定，本键优先。非 UUID 报配置错误且不复制，组织不同不复制并写日志。与其他第一方键一样，部署使配置受管理，用户在应用内设的第三方连接不再适用。Anthropic 可远程关闭复制。

rows.original: `auto` (default): use the OS sign-in broker where available (WAM on Windows, the Company Portal SSO extension on macOS) and fall back to a browser sign-in otherwise. `disabled`: always use the browser sign-in. `required`: fail sign-in when the broker is unavailable rather than falling back to the browser, so the refresh token stays broker-held. Linux has no broker, so `required` is not supported there. Desktop builds older than the version that introduced `required` treat it as `disabled` (browser-only sign-in) — the opposite posture — so gate rollout on client version.
rows.translation: `auto`（默认）可用时用系统登录代理（Windows WAM、macOS Company Portal SSO），否则回退浏览器。`disabled` 始终浏览器。`required` 代理不可用则登录失败，不回退，刷新令牌留在代理。Linux 无代理，不支持 `required`。早于引入 `required` 的构建将其视为 `disabled`，仅浏览器，行为相反，因此按客户端版本控制部署。

rows.original: Set this to the name users should see for this deployment (for example, "Claude for Government"). When unset, the desktop shows the default provider label. Maximum 60 characters.
rows.translation: 填写向用户显示的部署名称，例如“Claude for Government”。未设时显示默认提供商标签，最多 60 字符。

rows.original: Optional detail shown after the deployment display name in the account-menu header (for example, "Claude for Veterans Affairs · Claude for Government"). Shown only when the display name is also set. Maximum 60 characters.
rows.translation: 账户菜单标题中部署名称后的可选说明，例如“Claude for Veterans Affairs · Claude for Government”。仅同时设置名称时显示，最多 60 字符。

rows.original: When the organization's configuration uses a field that is deprecated — a renamed key, or a legacy value or entry form — the app shows every user a dismissable warning naming the field, what to use instead, and the date support ends (each field's cut-off is listed in the configuration changelog and takes effect at 12:00 PM Pacific Time on that date). The warning shows from the field's announced warning date until dismissed, and once more in the 24 hours before the cut-off. Set this to `true` to suppress the first showing for your users while you migrate; the final 24-hour reminder is always shown, and the deprecation stays listed in the diagnostic report (Help → Troubleshooting) and the hosted configuration editor regardless.
rows.translation: 配置使用弃用字段（改名键、旧值或旧格式）时，应用向所有用户显示可关闭警告，列字段、替代写法、截止日期（见配置变更日志，当日太平洋时间中午 12 点生效）。从公布警告日起显示至关闭，截止前 24 小时再提醒一次。`true` 可在迁移期抑制首次提示，最后 24 小时提醒始终显示；诊断报告（帮助 → 故障排查）和托管配置编辑器始终列出弃用信息。

rows.original: Runs only when set to `true`. When the app launches under this organization, it copies this computer's earlier third-party sessions (written under an earlier configuration, or by an earlier build) into its session store in the background, through the same importer Settings → Import uses (new session ids, except conversations previously imported from Claude.ai, which keep theirs; originals left in place). Runs at most once per device under device-delivered configuration (device management, a configuration file or a bootstrap URL) and once more after the device joins the organization's hosted configuration. Under the organization's hosted configuration it takes sessions from any earlier device configuration (including ones a console sign-in created) but never sessions stored under another organization's hosted configuration; under device-delivered configuration it takes only sessions stored while no organization ID was configured, and only once an organization ID is configured. Turn on `enabled` as well so users can import anything it leaves out by hand.
rows.translation: 仅 `true` 时运行。应用在此组织启动后，通过“设置 → 导入”同一导入器后台复制本机早期配置或旧版本的第三方会话到当前存储，使用新 ID；曾从 Claude.ai 导入的对话保留 ID，原件保留。设备配置（设备管理、文件、引导 URL）下每设备一次，加入组织托管配置后再一次。托管配置可取自任何早期设备配置（含控制台登录创建的），不取其他组织托管会话；设备配置仅在已设组织 ID 后，取此前没有组织 ID 时的会话。也请开启 `enabled`，供手动导入遗漏内容。

rows.original: Allows users to write this computer's chats, Cowork tasks, and Code sessions to a portable zip that another install can import from Settings > Import. Transcripts contain conversation content including tool outputs; only session-record metadata is projected to a fixed field allowlist. Treat exported zips as sensitive data.
rows.translation: 允许将本机聊天、Cowork 任务及 Code 会话导出为可移植 zip，在另一安装的“设置 > 导入”读取。记录包含对话正文及工具输出；只有会话记录元数据限定在固定字段允许名单内。请将导出的 zip 视为敏感数据。

rows.original: Use this for compliance notices, an internal-support link, or to identify the deployment. The banner is shown on every page after sign-in and cannot be dismissed by the user. Colors are six-digit hex (`#RRGGBB`); when `linkUrl` is set the banner text becomes an HTTPS link.
rows.translation: 用于合规通知、内部支持链接或标明部署身份。登录后每页都显示横幅，用户不能关闭。颜色为六位十六进制（`#RRGGBB`）；设置 `linkUrl` 后横幅文字成为 HTTPS 链接。

rows.original: Use these statements to limit what the add-in can do with sensitive files. A deny turns features off for files with a matching label. An allow turns features off for every file without a matching label. When a deny and an allow both match a file, the deny wins. When any statement checks uploaded files, the add-in also refuses uploads whose label it can’t read, such as encrypted or legacy Office files. If the add-in can’t read the policy, it turns off every feature.
rows.translation: 这些规则限制加载项对敏感文件的操作。拒绝规则关闭标签匹配文件的功能；允许规则关闭所有标签不匹配文件的功能。两者同时匹配时，拒绝优先。任何规则检查上传文件时，还会拒绝无法读取标签的上传，如加密或旧版 Office 文件。策略无法读取时，全部功能关闭。

rows.original:
Applies when `builtinBrowserEnabled` is on, in both Cowork and Code sessions, and decides which sites Claude may open, read, or act on with its browser tools; users can still view any site themselves. `allow` (default): every site except entries in `builtinBrowserBlockedDomains`. `block`: no site except entries in `builtinBrowserAllowedDomains`. Under either policy `coworkEgressAllowedHosts`, when set to anything but `*`, is an outer bound: sites outside it are refused to Claude in the browser too. A site Anthropic's site safety list blocks stays blocked to Claude under either policy (see `builtinBrowserEnabled`); for a site the list only flags for confirmation, Claude asks the user before each of its actions under `allow`, and skips that confirmation only when the site matches a `builtinBrowserAllowedDomains` entry under `block`. A value that cannot be read is treated as `block` until it is fixed.

The policy also limits what pages load: a page in the pane, including one a user opened, cannot load frames, scripts, images, or other content from a site the policy does not admit (a blocked page a user opens still loads content from its own site). Under `block`, or with a `coworkEgressAllowedHosts` list, include the CDN and API hosts your allowed sites depend on.

This key and the two site lists work the same way as the Claude in Chrome site policy in the admin console. They are set separately here, except on an install managed from the Claude admin console, where they follow your organization's browser site permissions there.
rows.translation:
`builtinBrowserEnabled` 开启时适用 Cowork 和 Code，决定 Claude 可通过浏览器工具打开、读取或操作哪些站点；用户仍可自行查看任意站点。`allow`（默认）允许除 `builtinBrowserBlockedDomains` 外的所有站点；`block` 仅允许 `builtinBrowserAllowedDomains`。两种策略下，`coworkEgressAllowedHosts` 若非 `*` 都构成外围限制，名单外站点也不允许 Claude 浏览。Anthropic 安全名单阻止的站点仍阻止（见 `builtinBrowserEnabled`）；仅标记为需确认的站点，在 `allow` 下逐操作询问，仅在 `block` 下匹配 `builtinBrowserAllowedDomains` 时免确认。不可读值按 `block` 处理，直至修复。

策略也限制页面加载：包括用户打开的页面，都不能从策略未允许的站点加载框架、脚本、图片或其他资源；用户打开的被阻止页面仍可加载其自身站点内容。在 `block` 或使用 `coworkEgressAllowedHosts` 列表时，也须列出允许站点依赖的 CDN 和 API 主机。

此键与两个名单和管理控制台 Claude in Chrome 站点策略方式相同，但在此分别设置；控制台管理的安装直接遵循组织浏览器站点权限。

rows.original:
Used when `builtinBrowserDefaultDomainPolicy` is `block`; ignored under `allow`. A site matching an entry is one Claude may open and work with using its browser tools; every other external site is treated as blocked by your organization: Claude cannot open it, cannot read or act on it, and frames, popups, and redirects into it from a page Claude is working on are refused. A user can still type its address and view it themselves. Listing a site here never unblocks a site Anthropic's site safety list blocks (see `builtinBrowserEnabled`); for a site that list only flags for confirmation, an entry here is your organization vouching for it, so Claude works with it without asking before each action.

Entries use the same grammar as `coworkEgressAllowedHosts`, except that bare `*` is dropped: as in Claude in Chrome, no allowed-sites entry opens every site. Set the policy to `allow` for that. A wildcard whose base is a public suffix (`*.co.uk`, `*.github.io`) is likewise ignored so an entry can never open a whole shared registry. Any other entry outside that grammar is kept but matches nothing (the app log and the editor name it); a value that cannot be read at all allows nothing until it is fixed. A plain hostname entry (`example.com`) also covers its `www.` form, and a `www.` entry covers the bare name, but no other subdomain. `localhost` dev servers are always reachable, so listing them changes nothing.

Empty or unset (default): under `block`, Claude may open no external site. On an install managed from the Claude admin console this follows your organization's browser site permissions there.
rows.translation:
`builtinBrowserDefaultDomainPolicy` 为 `block` 时使用，`allow` 下忽略。匹配条目的网站允许 Claude 使用工具打开和操作；其他外部站点视为组织阻止，Claude 不可打开、读取、操作，从正在操作页面进入它的框架、弹窗和重定向也拒绝。用户仍可手输地址自行查看。列出站点不会解除 Anthropic 安全名单阻止（见 `builtinBrowserEnabled`）；仅标记需确认的站点则视为组织担保，Claude 无需逐操作询问。

语法同 `coworkEgressAllowedHosts`，但丢弃单独 `*`，与 Claude in Chrome 相同，不能用名单条目开放全部站点，要实现此效果请设策略为 `allow`。根为公共后缀的通配符（`*.co.uk`、`*.github.io`）也忽略，避免开放整个共享注册域。其他不合语法条目保留但不匹配，日志和编辑器会指出；完全不可读的值不允许任何站点，直到修复。普通主机名（`example.com`）也覆盖 `www.`，`www.` 也覆盖裸域，但不覆盖其他子域。`localhost` 开发服务器始终可达，列出不会改变行为。

空或未设置（默认）时，`block` 下 Claude 不可访问外部站点。控制台管理的安装遵循组织浏览器站点权限。

rows.original:
Used when `builtinBrowserDefaultDomainPolicy` is `allow` (the default); ignored under `block`. A site matching an entry is treated as blocked by your organization: Claude cannot open it, cannot read or act on it with its browser tools, and frames, popups, and redirects into it from a page Claude is working on are refused. A user can still type its address and view it themselves: the pane shows a "blocked by your organization's policy" banner and Claude's tools stay off there. To take the external browser away from users as well, deploy Claude Code's `disableBrowserExternalNavigation` managed setting instead. A blocked site is refused before the site safety check, so its address is never sent to Anthropic.

Entries use the same grammar as `coworkEgressAllowedHosts`; `*` blocks every external site. An entry outside that grammar is kept but matches nothing (the app log and the editor name it); a value that cannot be read at all blocks every external site until it is fixed. As in Claude in Chrome, a plain hostname entry (`example.com`) also covers its `www.` form, and a `www.` entry covers the bare name, but no other subdomain. `localhost` dev servers are never affected.

Use this key for exceptions inside an allowed egress wildcard or when egress is open. Empty or unset (default): no sites beyond the egress list are blocked. On an install managed from the Claude admin console this follows your organization's browser site permissions there.
rows.translation:
`builtinBrowserDefaultDomainPolicy` 为 `allow`（默认）时使用，`block` 下忽略。匹配站点视为组织阻止：Claude 不可打开、读取、操作，从正在操作页面进入的框架、弹窗和重定向也拒绝。用户可自行输入地址查看，面板显示“被组织策略阻止”横幅，Claude 工具保持关闭。如需同时移除用户外部浏览器，请部署 Claude Code 的 `disableBrowserExternalNavigation` 托管设置。先实施阻止再安全检查，因此站点地址不发送给 Anthropic。

语法同 `coworkEgressAllowedHosts`，`*` 阻止所有外部站点。不合语法条目保留但不匹配，日志和编辑器会指出；完全不可读的值阻止所有外部站点，直到修复。与 Claude in Chrome 相同，普通主机名（`example.com`）覆盖 `www.`，`www.` 也覆盖裸域，不覆盖其他子域。`localhost` 开发服务器始终不受影响。

用于允许的出站通配范围内添加例外，或出站开放时添加限制。空或未设置（默认）时，不在出站列表之外额外阻止站点。控制台管理的安装遵循组织浏览器站点权限。

rows.original: The app deletes whole sessions in the background shortly after it fetches this configuration (at launch and on each re-poll), or some minutes after launch and then daily when the configuration comes from device management alone. Idle time runs from the session's last activity; viewing an old Code session counts as activity, viewing an old chat or Cowork task without continuing it does not durably. A session that is running or open on screen is skipped and checked again on the next pass, as is a chat or Cowork task whose folder changed on disk within the period. Pinned sessions are not exempt. Minimum 1 day; a value that cannot be read as a whole number of days deletes nothing. Set through the served configuration or in the device-management profile that carries the rest of the configuration. What it does not reach: another account's sessions on the device (evaluated when that account signs in), Code sessions on a remote machine (SSH/WSL), Cowork background (dispatch) tasks the sidebar does not list, a chat or Cowork task whose folder cannot be located, and Claude Code files not named by a session id (prompt history, plans, shell snapshots), which keep Claude Code's own retention. Honored only by Claude Desktop configured for a third-party model provider.
rows.translation: 应用获取此配置后不久（启动及每次轮询）在后台删除整个会话；若仅来自设备管理，则启动几分钟后开始，之后每天检查。无活动时间从最后活动计算：查看旧 Code 会话算活动，仅查看而不继续旧聊天或 Cowork 不会持久更新活动。正在运行或屏幕打开的会话会跳过，下次再查；期限内磁盘文件夹有变动的聊天或 Cowork 也跳过。置顶会话不豁免。最短 1 天；不能读取为整天数的值不删除任何内容。由服务器配置或包含其余配置的设备管理配置下发。以下不覆盖：本机其他账户会话（该账户登录时检查）、远程 SSH/WSL Code、侧边栏未列出的 Cowork 后台 dispatch 任务、无法定位文件夹的聊天/Cowork，以及不按会话 ID 命名的 Claude Code 文件（提示历史、计划、shell 快照），后者仍遵循 Claude Code 自身保留规则。仅第三方模型提供商配置的 Claude Desktop 实施。

rows.original: Meant to be set per user or group, through the served configuration's group overrides or in the same device-management profile that carries the rest of the configuration (a profile carrying only this key makes the device profile-managed, like any policy key); a hold in the device's profile also counts when the served configuration does not restate it. Deletion stops at the first configuration fetch that carries this value, before it takes effect as configuration at the next relaunch; a device that cannot reach its configuration server deletes nothing.
rows.translation: 应按用户或群组设置，通过服务器配置的群组覆盖，或包含其余配置的同一设备管理配置下发。仅包含此键的配置也与其他策略键一样使设备受管理；服务器未重申时，设备配置的暂停仍有效。首次获取含此值的配置后即停止删除，不必等下次重新启动应用配置。无法访问配置服务器的设备不删除内容。

rows.original: Setting this key asks for 3P mode. The app opens in 3P mode unless the user chose to sign in to Claude.ai at the login screen, a choice `disableDeploymentModeChooser` removes. In 3P mode, if the selected provider's required credential keys are missing or invalid, the app shows a configuration error. A value the app cannot read (a misspelt, wrongly cased or unknown provider, or a value of the wrong type) still counts as set when machine-wide device management sent it: a macOS configuration profile, Windows policy under `HKLM`, or the root-owned policy file on Linux. The app then asks for 3P mode and, in 3P mode, shows a configuration error whose details name this key. An unreadable `bootstrapUrl` from the same sources counts the same way unless `bootstrapEnabled` is `false`. An unreadable value does not count where the user can write it: the local configuration file, or Windows policy under `HKCU`. Neither does an empty value (a value of only spaces is unreadable, not empty), or a Windows value of type `REG_BINARY`, `REG_MULTI_SZ` or `REG_QWORD`. Each of those reads as not set. When this key is not set, the app launches in standard mode unless another setting asks for 3P mode, such as a `bootstrapUrl` that `bootstrapEnabled` has not turned off. Keys for providers other than the selected one are ignored. Each provider's required keys are documented on its dedicated page under Inference providers.
rows.translation: 设置此键请求第三方模式。除非用户在登录页选择 Claude.ai（`disableDeploymentModeChooser` 可移除此选择），应用使用第三方模式。所选提供商必需凭据键缺失或无效时显示配置错误。机器范围管理下发的不可读值（拼写/大小写错误、未知提供商或类型错误）仍算已设置：macOS 配置、Windows `HKLM` 策略、Linux root 所有文件；应用仍请求第三方模式，并在详情指出此键。同来源不可读的 `bootstrapUrl` 也如此，除非 `bootstrapEnabled` 为 `false`。用户可写来源（本地文件、Windows `HKCU` 策略）的不可读值不算已设置。空值（仅空格属于不可读，不是空值）和 Windows `REG_BINARY`、`REG_MULTI_SZ`、`REG_QWORD` 类型值也按未设置读取。未设时标准模式启动，除非其他设置请求第三方模式，例如未被 `bootstrapEnabled` 关闭的 `bootstrapUrl`。非所选提供商的键忽略。各提供商必需键见“推理提供商”下专页。

rows.original:
An entry with `transport: "policy-only"` is not a server: it sets tool permissions for an MCP server that an installed plugin provides, and nothing else. Set `name` to the server's name as the plugin declares it (matched case-insensitively) and `toolPolicy` to the permissions. The plugin keeps launching or connecting to its own server; the app never connects to, launches or lists anything for the entry, so it takes no `url`, `command`, `oauth` or other connection settings (an entry that sets one is rejected). It takes precedence over `orgPluginSettings` for that server in chat, Cowork and Code sessions alike; with no `toolPolicy` the server is left unrestricted. An entry whose name matches no installed plugin server does nothing.

Desktop versions that predate `policy-only` do not recognise it: they drop the entry (listed under Configuration parse errors in the diagnostics report) and apply `orgPluginSettings` to that server instead. If every entry in the list is `policy-only`, those versions cannot read `managedMcpServers` at all: they report a parse error for it and, until they are updated, leave MCP servers that users added themselves, or that a project's `.mcp.json` declares, out of Code sessions. While older versions are still in use, keep the same permissions in `orgPluginSettings` too, and do not deploy a list made only of `policy-only` entries until every desktop has updated.
rows.translation:
`transport: "policy-only"` 条目不是服务器，只设置已安装插件提供的 MCP 工具权限。`name` 填插件声明的服务器名（不区分大小写），`toolPolicy` 填权限。插件仍自己启动或连接，应用不为此条目连接、启动或列出任何服务器，因此不接受 `url`、`command`、`oauth` 等连接设置，包含则拒绝。聊天/Cowork/Code 中均优先于该服务器的 `orgPluginSettings`；无 `toolPolicy` 则不限制。名称不匹配已安装插件服务器时无效果。

早于 `policy-only` 的版本不识别，会丢弃条目并在诊断解析错误中列出，改用 `orgPluginSettings`。若全部条目均为 `policy-only`，旧版本无法读取整个 `managedMcpServers`，报解析错误，在更新前不向 Code 提供用户添加或项目 `.mcp.json` 声明的 MCP。仍使用旧版本时，也在 `orgPluginSettings` 保留相同权限；全设备更新前不要部署只有 `policy-only` 条目的列表。

rows.original: Also governs the same server when an installed plugin provides it. A plugin's MCP server matches an entry by URL, else by name (case-insensitive; a plugin server that runs locally matches by name only), and then follows that entry's `toolPolicy` alone: `orgPluginSettings` is not consulted for it, even when the entry sets no `toolPolicy`. A built-in entry (one with `server`) is the exception: it applies to a plugin's server of the same name only when a `toolPolicy` is written on it, and then carries that `toolPolicy` and the built-in's rule that its send and other irreversible tools cannot be loosened below `ask`, but not the built-in's other default prompts. An `http`, `sse` or `stdio` entry is also a server the app itself connects to or launches. To set permissions for a server that only a plugin runs, without the app connecting to or launching anything, use an entry with `transport: "policy-only"`.
rows.translation: 也控制已安装插件提供的相同服务器。优先按 URL，否则按名称匹配（不区分大小写，本地仅名称），匹配后仅遵循条目 `toolPolicy`，即使没设 `toolPolicy` 也不读取 `orgPluginSettings`。内置 `server` 条目例外：只有显式 `toolPolicy` 才作用于同名插件服务器，传递该 `toolPolicy` 和发送等不可逆工具不得低于 `ask` 的规则，不传递内置其他默认提示。`http`、`sse`、`stdio` 条目也由应用连接或启动。仅想设置插件运行服务器权限、不让应用连接或启动时，请使用 `transport: "policy-only"`。

rows.original: Only needed when the IdP completes sign-in from a host other than the authorization URL’s. When a callback is rejected for a referrer mismatch, the rejected host is named in the app log — add that hostname here.
rows.translation: 仅当 IdP 从授权 URL 之外的主机完成登录时需要。回调因来源不匹配被拒绝时，日志会指出被拒主机，将该主机名加入此处。

rows.original: Claude runs the executable with no arguments whenever that server connects and whenever its sign-in is refreshed in the background (the result is not cached), and reads **stdout**, which must be exactly one JSON object of the form `{"clientSecret": "…"}`: no other keys, and no banner or log lines before or after it (write those to stderr, which is only logged; keep stdout and stderr together under 64 KB). The helper must exit with code `0` within 30 seconds. Any other output stops that server from connecting, with an error that names its `clientSecretHelper`, instead of sending a wrong value to the identity provider. Use this to pull the secret from Keychain, 1Password CLI, or an internal secret broker instead of writing it into the configuration, and prefer a helper that does not prompt the user, since it also runs during background refreshes.
rows.translation: 每次服务器连接及后台刷新登录时，Claude 无参数运行此文件（结果不缓存），读取 **stdout**，必须恰为 `{"clientSecret": "…"}` 格式的单个 JSON，不得有其他键或前后横幅/日志。日志写到 stderr，仅记录；stdout/stderr 合计不超过 64 KB。助手须在 30 秒内以 `0` 退出。其他输出会阻止服务器连接并在错误中指出其 `clientSecretHelper`，避免向 IdP 发送错误值。用于从 Keychain、1Password CLI 或内部代理取机密，而非写入配置；也在后台运行，因此优先使用不提示用户的助手。

rows.original:
- **`browser`** (default) — opens the system browser for an authorization-code (PKCE) sign-in on the loopback redirect URI.
- **`broker`** — signs in through the OS identity broker (Web Account Manager on Windows, the Company Portal SSO extension on macOS), so it can satisfy Conditional Access policies that require a compliant or managed device or token protection. Requires **Tenant ID**, **Client ID**, and **Scope**. The app registration must list the broker redirect URIs `ms-appx-web://Microsoft.AAD.BrokerPlugin/{client-id}` (Windows) and `msauth.com.anthropic.claudefordesktop://auth` (macOS) under the **Mobile and desktop applications** platform, and the device must be Entra-registered (macOS also needs the Company Portal SSO extension). Not supported on Linux. When the broker is not available on a device, sign-in falls back to the system browser.

App versions that predate this key always use the system browser.
rows.translation:
- **`browser`**（默认）：系统浏览器通过回环 URI 执行授权码 PKCE 登录。
- **`broker`**：系统身份代理（Windows WAM、macOS Company Portal SSO），满足合规/受管理设备或令牌保护的条件访问。必填**租户 ID**、**客户端 ID**、**作用域**。注册须在**移动和桌面应用程序**平台列出 `ms-appx-web://Microsoft.AAD.BrokerPlugin/{client-id}`（Windows）、`msauth.com.anthropic.claudefordesktop://auth`（macOS），设备须 Entra 注册，macOS 还需 Company Portal SSO。Linux 不支持。设备代理不可用时回退系统浏览器。

早于此键的版本始终系统浏览器登录。

rows.original:
Leave off if Scope already includes `offline_access` or the server rejects it.

With explicit endpoints (Authorization URL / Token URL, no discovery) this toggle can’t take effect on its own — the app can’t confirm the AS advertises `offline_access`, so include `offline_access` in **Scope** instead for silent refresh.
rows.translation:
作用域已有 `offline_access` 或服务器拒绝它时保持关闭。

显式端点（授权 URL / 令牌 URL，无发现）下，此开关不能单独生效：应用不能确认授权服务器声明支持 `offline_access`。如需静默刷新，请在**作用域**直接包含 `offline_access`。

rows.original: **Auto-register**: Claude registers itself as a client with the MCP server’s authorization server the first time a user connects. **Bring your own client**: for a server whose provider requires an OAuth client that you register. Enter its **Client ID**, and add a **Client secret** and **Authorization server** only when the provider also requires the secret. Leave **None** for a server that needs no sign-in or authenticates with headers.
rows.translation: **自动注册：**首次连接时，Claude 向 MCP 授权服务器注册自身客户端。**自带客户端：**提供商要求你自行注册 OAuth 客户端时使用。填**客户端 ID**；仅提供商也要求机密时，添加**客户端密钥**及**授权服务器**。不需登录或用请求头认证的服务器选择**无**。

rows.original:
Absolute path to an executable that prints a single JSON object of environment variables to stdout, e.g. `{"API_KEY": "…"}`. The app runs it before spawning the server and merges the result over `env` (the helper wins on conflict). Use this to pull secrets from a secrets manager instead of storing them inline in `env`.

- If the helper fails, the server does not start; the failure names the helper path in the app log and the diagnostics report.
- A helper with nothing to set must print `{}`. Empty stdout is treated as a failure.
- A helper-emitted `PATH` replaces the static map’s `PATH` and supports the same `${PATH}` placeholder expansion as a static entry.
rows.translation:
向 stdout 输出单个环境变量 JSON 的可执行文件绝对路径，如 `{"API_KEY": "…"}`。启动服务器前运行，结果覆盖 `env`，冲突以助手为准。用于从机密管理器取值，避免内联存于 `env`。

- 失败则不启动服务器，在日志和诊断中指出助手路径。
- 无需设置值时须输出 `{}`，空 stdout 视为失败。
- 助手 `PATH` 替换静态映射 `PATH`，支持相同 `${PATH}` 占位符展开。

rows.original: How long the app may reuse the helper's output before running it again. The check happens only when the server process is (re)started. Environment variables are fixed at process creation, and a running server never sees refreshed values until its next restart. Set this at or below your token lifetime: a server that crash-loops because its token expired can be respawned with the same cached environment until the TTL lapses. Default: 300 seconds.
rows.translation: 重新运行助手前可复用输出的时间，仅在服务器进程启动或重启时检查。环境变量在创建进程时固定，运行中服务器须重启才能看到新值。应设为不长于令牌寿命；令牌到期导致反复崩溃时，TTL 到期前重启仍可能用相同缓存环境。默认 300 秒。

rows.original: With Continuous Access Evaluation the server declares the `cp1` client capability, so Microsoft Entra issues access tokens that live up to about 28 hours and are cut off within minutes by a claims challenge when an administrator revokes sessions, disables the account, or the user’s risk changes — and, where the tenant enforces an IP named-location or Global Secure Access compliant-network Conditional Access policy, when the token is presented from outside that network. Tenants without such a policy get the longer lifetime and the fast revocation but no network-based replay protection; set `disabled` to keep standard one-hour, non-CAE tokens on every sign-in path. A change applies to tokens issued after the connector respawns with it; an already-cached long-lived token is served until it expires (Disconnect → Connect signs in afresh).
rows.translation: 持续访问评估下，服务器声明 `cp1` 客户端能力，Microsoft Entra 签发最长约 28 小时的访问令牌。管理员撤销会话、禁用账户或用户风险改变时，通过声明质询在几分钟内撤销；租户实施 IP 命名位置或 Global Secure Access 合规网络条件访问时，从网络外提交也会撤销。无此策略的租户有长有效期和快速撤销，但无按网络防重放。设为 `disabled` 可在所有登录路径保留标准一小时非 CAE 令牌。更改对连接器重新启动后新签发的令牌生效；已缓存长令牌继续使用到到期，“断开 → 连接”可重新登录。

rows.original:
For inference providers without native web search (Bedrock, custom gateways). On Anthropic API and Vertex, the model’s built-in web search is available without this.

The provider’s API key is a credential — have the **headers helper script** print its auth header rather than storing it in `headers`:
- **Brave** — `X-Subscription-Token`
- **Exa** — `x-api-key`
- **Tavily** — `Authorization` (Bearer …)

To turn web search off entirely, or to require approval for each search, list the bare `WebSearch` name in `disabledBuiltinTools` or `builtinToolPolicy`; it takes no per-host scope.
rows.translation:
用于无原生网页搜索的提供商（Bedrock、自定义网关）。Anthropic API/Vertex 的模型内置搜索无需此项。

提供商 API 密钥是凭据，应让**请求头助手脚本**输出认证头，不存于 `headers`：
- **Brave**：`X-Subscription-Token`
- **Exa**：`x-api-key`
- **Tavily**：`Authorization`（Bearer …）

完全关闭或逐次审批搜索时，在 `disabledBuiltinTools` 或 `builtinToolPolicy` 列出单独 `WebSearch`，不支持按主机限定范围。

rows.original: Absolute path to an executable that prints a single JSON object of request headers to stdout, e.g. `{"X-Subscription-Token": "…"}`. The app runs it before each request and caches the result for the TTL below. Use this to pull the key from a secrets manager instead of storing it inline in `headers`.
rows.translation: 向 stdout 输出单个请求头 JSON 的可执行文件绝对路径，例如 `{"X-Subscription-Token": "…"}`。每次请求前运行并按下方 TTL 缓存，用于从机密管理器获取密钥，不内联存于 `headers`。

rows.original: In **access-token** mode the token's audience must be your gateway or proxy. On IdPs where the requested scopes decide the audience (**Entra ID**), include its API resource scope in `scopes` — `api://<gateway-app-id>/.default`, or a named delegated scope you exposed via *Expose an API*. With only the standard OIDC scopes (`openid profile email offline_access`) Entra returns a v1.0 Microsoft Graph token whose issuer (`https://sts.windows.net/<tenant>/`) doesn't match the v2.0 issuer configured here, so a gateway that validates `iss` rejects it. On IdPs that set the access-token audience out-of-band (Keycloak audience mapper, Auth0 default audience, Okta custom authorization server), a resource scope in `scopes` isn't required — the audience comes from the IdP-side configuration.
rows.translation: **访问令牌**模式的受众须为网关或代理。请求作用域决定受众的 IdP（**Entra ID**）须在 `scopes` 包含 API 资源作用域：`api://<gateway-app-id>/.default` 或通过*公开 API*注册的命名委托作用域。仅标准 OIDC 作用域（`openid profile email offline_access`）时，Entra 返回 v1.0 Microsoft Graph 令牌，其签发方（`https://sts.windows.net/<tenant>/`）与此处 v2.0 不符，检查 `iss` 的网关会拒绝。IdP 通过其他配置决定受众（Keycloak audience mapper、Auth0 default audience、Okta custom authorization server）时，`scopes` 无需资源作用域，受众来自 IdP 设置。

rows.original: Turn off only if your authorization server rejects `offline_access` as an unknown scope; include the server’s own refresh-token scope in **Scopes** instead.
rows.translation: 仅授权服务器将 `offline_access` 作为未知作用域拒绝时才关闭，改在**作用域**包含该服务器自有刷新令牌作用域。

rows.original:
Set this only for an IdP that implements RFC 8707 resource indicators. The app then sends `resource=<value>` on the authorization, token and refresh requests, so the access token the IdP issues is audience-restricted to the gateway or proxy rather than to the IdP's own APIs. Use it with `bearerTokenType: access_token`; in `id_token` mode the ID token's audience is always `clientId`. Ignored with the OS-broker sign-in flow (the sign-in flow key set to `broker`), which is Entra-only.

**Microsoft Entra ID:** leave unset — the v2.0 endpoint rejects `resource`; request the API scope in `scopes` instead (`api://<gateway-app-id>/.default`). **AD FS:** enter one of the relying-party trust's identifiers, spelled as it is registered there. A value with no scheme (a host name with or without a port or path, a single name, or a GUID; `name:digits` also reads as a host name with a port) is sent as `https://<value>`; an identifier with a scheme of its own (`urn:…`, or an organization-defined one such as `VENDOR:URI:…`) is sent exactly as written. A trust whose only identifier is a bare name or GUID will not match, because those are sent as `https://<value>`: add an `https://…` or `urn:…` identifier to the trust and enter that one here. With any other identity provider, use an absolute URI without a fragment (RFC 8707 — the IdP rejects one as `invalid_target`). Changing it signs users in again.
rows.translation:
仅实现 RFC 8707 资源指示器的 IdP 使用。应用在授权、令牌、刷新请求发送 `resource=<value>`，使访问令牌受众限定为网关或代理，而非 IdP 自身 API。配合 `bearerTokenType: access_token` 使用；`id_token` 模式的 ID 令牌受众始终为 `clientId`。仅 Entra 的系统身份代理流程（`broker`）忽略此项。

**Microsoft Entra ID：**留空，v2.0 拒绝 `resource`，改在 `scopes` 请求 API 作用域（`api://<gateway-app-id>/.default`）。**AD FS：**填写依赖方信任已注册的一个标识，拼写须一致。无协议值（可带端口/路径的主机名、单名称、GUID；`name:digits` 也按主机加端口）作为 `https://<value>` 发送；自带协议的标识（`urn:…` 或组织自定义 `VENDOR:URI:…`）原样发送。信任若仅有纯名称/GUID，会因按 `https://<value>` 发送而不匹配，应添加 `https://…` 或 `urn:…` 标识并填写。其他 IdP 用无片段的绝对 URI（RFC 8707，否则报 `invalid_target`）。修改会使用户重新登录。

rows.original: For a plugin server that Claude Code launches or connects to itself (a marketplace plugin's), the permissions travel on Claude Code's managed-settings channel: another Claude Code [managed-settings source](
rows.translation: Claude Code 自行启动或连接的插件服务器（来自市场插件）的权限通过其托管设置渠道传递；本机其他 Claude Code [托管设置来源](

rows.original: /code#interaction-with-claude-code%E2%80%99s-own-managed-settings) on the device replaces them unless that source sets `parentSettingsBehavior` to `"merge"`. `blocked` on a server the app connects to itself holds either way.
rows.translation: /code#interaction-with-claude-code%E2%80%99s-own-managed-settings) 会替换这些权限，除非将 `parentSettingsBehavior` 设为 `"merge"`。由应用自行连接的服务器，其 `blocked` 在两种情况下均生效。

rows.original: Broker mode mints a token in the customer's own Entra tenant with the customer-configured `scopes` and forwards it to the customer's own gateway or proxy; both endpoints of that trust relationship are inside the customer's control.
rows.translation: 身份代理模式在客户自己的 Entra 租户中，按客户配置的 `scopes` 签发令牌，并转发给客户自己的网关或代理；这份信任关系的两端均由客户控制。

rows.original: Broker mode mints a token in the customer's own Entra tenant with the customer-configured `scopes`, and forwards it to the customer's own gateway; both endpoints of that trust relationship are inside the customer's control. A desktop that has the `external-idp` kind reads this key, together with `inferenceGatewayOidc`, as that kind's sign-in flow; it stays readable.
rows.translation: 身份代理模式在客户自己的 Entra 租户中，按客户配置的 `scopes` 签发令牌，并转发给客户自己的网关；两端均由客户控制。支持 `external-idp` 类型的桌面将此键与 `inferenceGatewayOidc` 一起读取为该类型的登录流程，旧写法仍可读取。

rows.original: The GCP STS token-exchange step is unchanged in either flow; only how the Entra id_token is acquired differs.
rows.translation: 两种流程的 GCP STS 令牌交换步骤相同，仅取得 Entra id_token 的方式不同。
